title: The enemy roster: every one described

cards.title: How the roster works
cards.text: Variants, elites with trinkets, mini-boss forms, and floors that differ. Mark any rule that's off.
cards.why: These rules decide how much art and how much variety the roster costs.

parts.title: Variants
parts.text: A variant is a recolour of a base enemy (a hue shift, maybe a small accent) with its own kit: the orange goblin, the golden skeleton, the fire spider. Cheap on art, big on variety.

parts.title: Elites
parts.text: Any kind can be elite, as now, with its own extra move. Size sits between normal and mini-boss. Elites may spawn carrying a trinket they use (it shows on them, and drops when they die); rarely, two.

parts.title: Mini-bosses
parts.text: Besides the named ones, any kind can show up as a mini-boss form: bigger than an elite, stronger, and with two extra moves.

parts.title: Floors
parts.text: Each dungeon's three floors differ in enemies, hazards and mood, not only in strength (see each dungeon's floors). Floors 1 and 2 end in two different mini-bosses, floor 3 in the boss.

cards.title: 1. The Wildwood
cards.text: A forest. The new first dungeon. Mark each enemy you'd change or cut.
cards.why: You asked to hear each one before it goes in. Every enemy is its own part.
cards.details: Floor 1, the forest edge: wolves, slimes, bandit scouts, brambles. Floor 2, the bandit camp: bandits, snares, campfires. Floor 3, the old grove: ents, sproutlings, wisps, grasping roots.

parts.title: Wolf
parts.text: (new) Fast pack hunter. Circles a hero, then lunges. Its howl turns the whole pack onto one hero.

parts.title: Dire wolf
parts.text: (variant of Wolf) Black and bigger. Pounces from far off and pins a hero for a second.

parts.title: Slime
parts.text: (in) As now: splits in two when it dies.

parts.title: Moss slime
parts.text: (variant of Slime) Dark green. Leaves a trail of moss that slows; splits into three.

parts.title: Goblin
parts.text: (in) Small knife fighter, comes in groups.

parts.title: Orange goblin
parts.text: (variant of Goblin) Yours: 1.5x as fast, weaves in and out of the fight and never stands still.

parts.title: Bandit
parts.text: (new) Sword and buckler. Blocks the first hit, and each hit steals a few coins: kill it to get them back.

parts.title: Bandit archer
parts.text: (new) Shoots from behind cover and moves to a new spot after every shot.

parts.title: Poacher
parts.text: (variant of Bandit archer) Green hood. Lays snares on the floor and fires a net that pins a hero.

cards.title: 1. The Wildwood, part 2
cards.text: The rest of it, with its mini-bosses and boss.
cards.why: You asked to hear each one before it goes in. Every enemy is its own part.
cards.details: Floor 1, the forest edge: wolves, slimes, bandit scouts, brambles. Floor 2, the bandit camp: bandits, snares, campfires. Floor 3, the old grove: ents, sproutlings, wisps, grasping roots.

parts.title: Bandit brute
parts.text: (new) Big club. A slow wind-up slam that sends heroes flying.

parts.title: Thornback boar
parts.text: (new) Charges in a straight line. If it hits a wall or a rock it staggers itself.

parts.title: Sproutling
parts.text: (new) A small walking sapling, always in groups. Roots itself to heal if left alone.

parts.title: Ent
parts.text: (new) A huge slow tree. Slams roots up in a line. Takes extra from fire, and drops sproutlings when hit hard.

parts.title: Wisp
parts.text: (new) A floating light. Blinks about, zaps, and heals beasts near it: kill it first.

parts.title: The Alpha
parts.text: (mini-boss) A giant wolf. Calls packs in waves; its howl makes every wolf faster for a while.

parts.title: The Bandit Chief
parts.text: (mini-boss) Smoke bombs that hide the room, a fan of thrown knives, and a whistle that brings archers.

parts.title: The Elder Ent
parts.text: (boss) Root cages that pin, falling branches you see coming, a grove of sproutlings that feed it. Set it alight and it rampages: faster, but burning down.

cards.title: 2. The Warren
cards.text: Goblin tunnels. Mark each enemy you'd change or cut.
cards.why: You asked to hear each one before it goes in. Every enemy is its own part.
cards.details: Floor 1, the tunnels: goblins, rats, snares. Floor 2, the war camp: hobgoblins, orcs, wolf riders, firepits. Floor 3, the deep halls: trolls, shamans, the war drums.

parts.title: Goblin, Hobgoblin, Orc, Or
parts.text: Goblin, Hobgoblin, Orc, Orc shaman, Troll, Rat (in): As now (the hobgoblin's war cry, the orc's charge, the shaman's fireballs, the troll's regrowth).

parts.title: Goblin bomber
parts.text: (variant of Goblin) Red cap. Lobs bombs with a lit fuse; they sit a moment before they blow.

parts.title: Wolf rider
parts.text: (new) A goblin on a wolf. Charges through the party; when the wolf dies the goblin fights on foot.

parts.title: Frost shaman
parts.text: (variant of Orc shaman) Blue. Chills instead of burns, and plants ice totems that slow everyone near.

parts.title: Rock troll
parts.text: (variant of Troll) Grey. Throws boulders. Stone skin shrugs off damage until it's staggered.

parts.title: Drummer
parts.text: (new) A goblin with a war drum. Does no damage; everything near it attacks faster while it plays.

parts.title: The Beastmaster
parts.text: (mini-boss) A hobgoblin with a whip and three wolves. The wolves get stronger each time one dies.

parts.title: The Twin Trolls
parts.text: (mini-boss) Two trolls that heal each other. They have to go down close together.

parts.title: The Warboss
parts.text: (boss) A proper fight this time: charges, a spinning cleaver, and war drums round the room that call waves until they're smashed.

cards.title: 3. The Sewers
cards.text: Under the city. Mark each enemy you'd change or cut.
cards.why: You asked to hear each one before it goes in. Every enemy is its own part.
cards.details: Floor 1, the drains: rats, slimes, gas. Floor 2, the canals: lizardmen, crabs, deep water. Floor 3, the cistern: the drowned, crocs, the dark.

parts.title: Rat, Slime, Lizardman, Liz
parts.text: Rat, Slime, Lizardman, Lizard blade (in): As now (the lizardman's tail spin soaks).

parts.title: Plague rat
parts.text: (variant of Rat) Sickly green. Bursts into a poison cloud when it dies.

parts.title: Sludge slime
parts.text: (variant of Slime) Brown. Leaves oil wherever it goes, and burns fiercely if lit.

parts.title: Croc
parts.text: (new) Bites and holds, then rolls, dragging the hero. Fast in water, slow out of it.

parts.title: Sewer crab
parts.text: (new) Armoured from the front. Sidesteps, then grabs with a pincer: hit it from behind.

cards.title: 3. The Sewers, part 2
cards.text: The rest of it, with its mini-bosses and boss.
cards.why: You asked to hear each one before it goes in. Every enemy is its own part.
cards.details: Floor 1, the drains: rats, slimes, gas. Floor 2, the canals: lizardmen, crabs, deep water. Floor 3, the cistern: the drowned, crocs, the dark.

parts.title: The Drowned
parts.text: (new) A waterlogged corpse. Grabs a hero and drags them toward the water. Soaks.

parts.title: Leech
parts.text: (new) Tiny. Latches onto a hero and drains them until an ally knocks it off.

parts.title: The Rat King
parts.text: (mini-boss) A knot of rats. Splits into a swarm when hit and re-forms; hurt the swarm to hurt the king.

parts.title: The Lizard Chief
parts.text: (mini-boss) Spear and tide: floods part of the room, and everything in the water with him is faster.

parts.title: The Thing in the Cistern
parts.text: (boss) Never fully seen. Tentacles rise from the canals to slam and grab; the water level rises through the fight.

cards.title: 4. The Crypt
cards.text: Old graves under the hill. Mark each enemy you'd change or cut.
cards.why: You asked to hear each one before it goes in. Every enemy is its own part.
cards.details: Floor 1, the catacombs: rattlers, bone hounds, grave mist. Floor 2, the chapel: acolytes, cursed armour, ghosts. Floor 3, the royal tombs: golden dead, wraiths, the King.

parts.title: Rattler (sword, bow, spear
parts.text: Rattler (sword, bow, spear, mace), Gaper, Brute (in): As now.

parts.title: Ghost
parts.text: (in) Now gives Curse (no healing, more damage taken) instead of chill.

parts.title: Banshee
parts.text: (in) Moves here from the Frost Hollow as well: her scream slows and curses.

parts.title: Golden skeleton
parts.text: (variant of Rattler) Yours: drops double gold, and summons golden bones all round it that home in, go through heroes and hit 1.5x as hard.

parts.title: Bone hound
parts.text: (new) A fast skeletal dog. Falls apart when killed, then pulls itself together once.

parts.title: Acolyte
parts.text: (new) A hooded cultist. Raises fallen skeletons back up: kill it first.

cards.title: 4. The Crypt, part 2
cards.text: The rest of it, with its mini-bosses and boss.
cards.why: You asked to hear each one before it goes in. Every enemy is its own part.
cards.details: Floor 1, the catacombs: rattlers, bone hounds, grave mist. Floor 2, the chapel: acolytes, cursed armour, ghosts. Floor 3, the royal tombs: golden dead, wraiths, the King.

parts.title: Cursed armour
parts.text: (new) An empty suit of armour. Collapses when beaten, and stands back up unless its helmet is hit while down.

parts.title: Wraith
parts.text: (variant of Ghost) Dark. Its curse also steals the healing meant for its target.

parts.title: The Grave Warden
parts.text: (mini-boss) As now, tuned up: raises a ring of dead and slams the ground.

parts.title: The Ossuary
parts.text: (mini-boss) A heap of bones that builds itself bigger from every skeleton that dies near it.

parts.title: The Bone King
parts.text: (boss) Stronger: a fourth phase after the dark one where he raises his whole court at once, and his lance leaves a wall of bone behind it.

cards.title: 5. The Frost Hollow
cards.text: Ice caves. Mark each enemy you'd change or cut.
cards.why: You asked to hear each one before it goes in. Every enemy is its own part.
cards.details: Floor 1, the snowfield: frost wolves, snowmen, bats. Floor 2, the web caves: spiders, ice slimes, frozen pools. Floor 3, the glacier heart: yetis, ogres, blizzards.

parts.title: Bat, Snowman, Hunter spide
parts.text: Bat, Snowman, Hunter spider, Momma spider, Ogre (in): As now.

parts.title: Frost wolf
parts.text: (variant of Wolf) White. Its bite chills, and a pack can freeze a hero solid.

parts.title: Ice slime
parts.text: (variant of Slime) Pale blue. Leaves ice that makes heroes slip, and shatters into shards when killed.

parts.title: Frost spider
parts.text: (variant of Hunter spider) Its webs chill instead of only slowing.

parts.title: Yeti
parts.text: (new) Throws snow boulders from range, and roars to stagger anything close.

parts.title: Icicle sprite
parts.text: (new) Hangs back and drops icicles from above: a shadow shows where.

parts.title: The Brood Queen
parts.text: (mini-boss) A giant spider. Webs up the exits, and her eggs hatch unless they're broken.

parts.title: Old Frost
parts.text: (mini-boss) An elder yeti. Rolls giant snowballs across the room that grow as they go.

parts.title: The Winter Queen
parts.text: (boss) An ice mage. Walls of ice split the party, a blizzard hides the room, and she must be reached while her mirror images shatter.

cards.title: 6. The Ember Deep
cards.text: Fire and brimstone. Mark each enemy you'd change or cut.
cards.why: You asked to hear each one before it goes in. Every enemy is its own part.
cards.details: Floor 1, the ash wastes: imps, cinder bats, burning ground. Floor 2, the forges: devils, magma golems, lava flows. Floor 3, the pit: demons, dragonborn, the drake.

parts.title: Imp, Fire slime, Devil, De
parts.text: Imp, Fire slime, Devil, Demon, Dragonborn (in): As now.

parts.title: Fire spider
parts.text: (variant of Hunter spider) Yours: burns instead of poisons, and spits fireballs.

parts.title: Hellhound
parts.text: (variant of Wolf) Leaves a trail of fire where it runs, and breathes a short cone of flame.

parts.title: Cinder bat
parts.text: (variant of Bat) Dives at a hero and explodes.

parts.title: Magma golem
parts.text: (new) Slow, and leaves fire where it walks. Soak or chill it and it cracks: stunned and brittle.

parts.title: Ash wraith
parts.text: (variant of Ghost) Throws ash that blinds: a blinded hero can only hit what's right next to it.

parts.title: The Pit Lord
parts.text: (mini-boss) As now, tuned up: a whip of fire and rifts that spit imps.

parts.title: The Dragonborn Champion
parts.text: (mini-boss) A duellist. Marks one hero and hunts them; breaks off only when staggered.

parts.title: Cinder, the Old Drake
parts.text: (boss) A dragon. Breath in a sweeping cone, a wing gust that scatters the party, and passes overhead that strafe a line of fire.

cards.title: 7. The Gilded Spire
cards.text: A temple in the clouds. Mark each enemy you'd change or cut.
cards.why: You asked to hear each one before it goes in. Every enemy is its own part.
cards.details: Floor 1, the steps: cherubs, sun blades, sigils. Floor 2, the choir halls: angels, choir sprites, light beams. Floor 3, the sanctum: seraphs, golems, the fallen.

parts.title: Cherub, Angel, Seraph
parts.text: (in) Now give Radiance (slower, much weaker attacks; at full, a glowing aura that spreads it and stops you attacking).

parts.title: Fallen angel
parts.text: (variant of Angel) Dark wings. Gives Curse instead of Radiance.

parts.title: Sun blade
parts.text: (new) A floating sword. Spins through the party in straight lines; can't be staggered.

parts.title: Choir sprite
parts.text: (new) Sings: everything in its song heals. Silenced by a stagger.

parts.title: Gilded golem
parts.text: (new) A gold statue. Shots from the front bounce back at the shooter.

parts.title: The Twin Heralds
parts.text: (mini-boss) One of light, one fallen. Each heals in the other's aura, so they have to be pulled apart.

parts.title: The Archon
parts.text: (mini-boss) As now, tuned up: pillars of light that sweep the room like clock hands.

parts.title: The Hollow Saint
parts.text: (boss) A statue with nothing inside. Radiance floods the room in pulses, and the only shade is behind the pillars it hasn't yet broken.

cards.title: 8. The Sunken Dunes (new)
cards.text: A desert tomb. Mark each enemy you'd change or cut.
cards.why: You asked to hear each one before it goes in. Every enemy is its own part.
cards.details: Floor 1, the dunes: scarabs, cobras, quicksand. Floor 2, the buried halls: jackal guards, mummies, dart traps. Floor 3, the sun chamber: sand mages, wurms, the Pharaoh.

parts.title: Scarab
parts.text: (new) Small, in swarms. Burrows and pops up under a hero.

parts.title: Cobra
parts.text: (new) Spits poison from range and rears back out of reach.

parts.title: Golden cobra
parts.text: (variant of Cobra) Its spit blinds instead; drops extra gold.

parts.title: Jackal guard
parts.text: (new) Spear and shield. Sidesteps a blow, then counters.

parts.title: Mummy
parts.text: (new) Slow. Its wrappings pull a hero in, and its touch curses. Burns easily.

parts.title: Scorpion
parts.text: (new) Pincers hold a hero still for the sting, which staggers.

cards.title: 8. The Sunken Dunes (new), part 2
cards.text: The rest of it, with its mini-bosses and boss.
cards.why: You asked to hear each one before it goes in. Every enemy is its own part.
cards.details: Floor 1, the dunes: scarabs, cobras, quicksand. Floor 2, the buried halls: jackal guards, mummies, dart traps. Floor 3, the sun chamber: sand mages, wurms, the Pharaoh.

parts.title: Sand mage
parts.text: (new) Raises a sandstorm that shortens everyone's reach inside it.

parts.title: Sand wurm
parts.text: (new) Burrows, then erupts under a hero: the ground shakes first.

parts.title: The Tomb Guard
parts.text: (mini-boss) A giant jackal statue that wakes. Slow, heavy, and the floor traps are on its side.

parts.title: The Wurm Mother
parts.text: (mini-boss) Dives in and out of the sand; only her tail can be hurt while she's under.

parts.title: The Sun Pharaoh
parts.text: (boss) Burning sun discs that cross the room, a curse on whoever stands in his gaze, and a guard of mummies he calls from the walls.

cards.title: 9. The Clockwork Foundry (new)
cards.text: A factory that never stopped. Mark each enemy you'd change or cut.
cards.why: You asked to hear each one before it goes in. Every enemy is its own part.
cards.details: Floor 1, the scrapyard: gear sprites, bomb bots, crushers. Floor 2, the assembly line: automatons, turrets, conveyors. Floor 3, the engine room: tesla coils, smiths, steam.

parts.title: Gear sprite
parts.text: (new) A rolling cog. Bounces off walls and through the party.

parts.title: Bomb bot
parts.text: (new) Walks up, ticks, and explodes. Knock it away in time and it blows up its own side.

parts.title: Automaton
parts.text: (new) A sword construct. Hits hard, then overheats and stands open for a moment.

parts.title: Steam turret
parts.text: (new) Doesn't move. Turns slowly to fire: get behind it.

parts.title: Tesla coil
parts.text: (new) Shock that chains between heroes; much worse on anyone wet.

cards.title: 9. The Clockwork Foundry (new), part 2
cards.text: The rest of it, with its mini-bosses and boss.
cards.why: You asked to hear each one before it goes in. Every enemy is its own part.
cards.details: Floor 1, the scrapyard: gear sprites, bomb bots, crushers. Floor 2, the assembly line: automatons, turrets, conveyors. Floor 3, the engine room: tesla coils, smiths, steam.

parts.title: Repair drone
parts.text: (new) Floats about mending constructs. Kill it first.

parts.title: Foundry smith
parts.text: (new) A big brute with a red-hot hammer. Every hit burns.

parts.title: The Foreman
parts.text: (mini-boss) Rides a walking crane. Drops crates on heroes and winds up broken constructs again.

parts.title: The Twin Pistons
parts.text: (mini-boss) Two great hammers that take turns slamming halves of the room.

parts.title: The Great Engine
parts.text: (boss) Doesn't move. Arms that sweep, vents that scald, and a core that only opens when it overheats.
